jurisdiction.name: Paraguay
jurisdiction.overview: Nationally published records appear separately from applicable EU-level records. The landscape, historical relationships and legal applicability remain under document-level review.

narrative.summary: Paraguay has no AI law or adopted national AI strategy. The only AI instrument found is the Supreme Court's 2026 operational policy setting binding guidelines for the use of AI systems, including generative AI, in the Judiciary. The ICT ministry (MITIC) is preparing a national AI roadmap after a UNESCO readiness assessment, AI bills are pending in Congress, and a comprehensive personal data protection law (Law 7593 of 2025) has been promulgated.
lead_institutions: Ministerio de Tecnologías de la Información y Comunicación (MITIC)
narrative.review_notes: This review was carried out on 12 October 2026, but the Official Gazette, Congress's bill system, the Chamber of Deputies', the central bank's and the Presidency's websites could not be accessed, so only one document could be read. Paraguay is marked for a later retry. The 2025 data protection law, the AI bills and the national AI roadmap are tracked as leads.

instruments.official_title: Política Operacional que establece directrices para el uso de sistemas de inteligencia artificial en el Poder Judicial
instruments.english_title: Operational Policy establishing guidelines for the use of artificial intelligence systems in the Judiciary (approved by Supreme Court Resolution No. 12,677)
instruments.issuing_authority: Supreme Court of Justice (Corte Suprema de Justicia)
instruments.current_status: Approved by Supreme Court Resolution No. 12.677 of 4 March 2026 (Version 1), which authorises its application; the Poder Judicial announced it on 9 April 2026. A working group set up under Acta No. 5/2025 of the Consejo de Superintendencia reports periodically to the Internal Control Committee on implementation.
instruments.summary: Supreme Court resolution approving a binding operational policy for magistrates and officials of the Paraguayan Judiciary who use, develop, acquire or supervise AI systems, covering existing and future, in-house and third-party systems. It sets principles of human oversight, transparency and open justice, among others, lists permitted support uses (legal research, summaries, translation, draft structuring) subject to human verification, and prohibits delegating judicial or administrative decisions to AI, fully automating processes affecting fundamental rights, determining guilt or setting penalties without human intervention. It defines generative AI, LLMs, chatbots and agents, and addresses hallucinations, over-reliance and algorithmic bias.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: First binding AI-use rules issued by a Paraguayan state body; governs AI use across the entire judiciary.

coverage_audit.no_material_found_note: Paraguay's national law library, the ICT ministry, ministries (including the judiciary) and regulators were searched. No qualifying AI-governance document was found for binding law, strategy, government AI governance, risk and assurance, procurement, cybersecurity, data and privacy, transparency, standards, sandboxes, readiness indices, drafts, international agreements or historical publications. The official gazette, the bill search, the Chamber of Deputies, the central bank and the Presidency sites were unavailable, so the new data protection law, two AI bills and a possible national AI roadmap are listed as leads to check later.
coverage_audit.technical_note: Coverage note (original): Technical review notes: tier B/C batch run 2026-10-12, one agent, national level only (PROTOCOL §6), about 25-minute time box. gacetaoficial.gov.py reset/503; SILpy JS-only (search unusable); diputados.gov.py TLS name mismatch / 503; bcp.gov.py 403; presidencia.gov.py reset. BACN law collection stops at 2024. MITIC guias/lineamientos/publicaciones/informes/resoluciones/marco-legal: AI mentions only events/travel. Ley 7593/2025 (data protection) official text not reachable - lead. Judiciary PEI 2026-2030 action 3.8 internal (scope test, lead). Convention 108: not a party. Units covered: Law: BACN (collection ends at 2024 laws; no AI law), Gaceta Oficial attempted (unreachable), SILpy attempted (script-only); no AI law in force; two AI bills and Ley 7593/2025 held as leads; Government: MITIC site searched (search, guias-y-documentos, lineamientos-tic, publicaciones, informes, resoluciones, marco-legal): only event/travel resolutions mentioning AI; no national AI strategy, public-sector AI guideline or published roadmap text found; Ministries: Education (MEC), health, finance, defence, labour, interior: searched, nothing found. Judiciary (Supreme Court): binding AI-use policy found and recorded; Regulators: Data protection agency (created by Ley 7593, not yet operating publicly), BCP (site 403), CONATEL, DNCP, CERT-Py: searched, no AI-specific instruments found. Not reached: Gaceta Oficial (gacetaoficial.gov.py: connection reset / HTTP 503); SILpy bill search (JavaScript-only application); diputados.gov.py (TLS name mismatch / 503); bcp.gov.py (HTTP 403); presidencia.gov.py (connection reset). Could not verify: Ley 7593/2025 official text and dates (gazette unreachable); AI bill numbers and status on SILpy; Whether MITIC has formally published the National AI Roadmap. binding-law, strategy, government-governance, risk-assurance, procurement, cyber-security, data-privacy, transparency, standards, sandbox, index-readiness, drafts, international, historical: no material found.

leads.title: Ley N° 7593/2025 De Protección de Datos Personales
leads.english_title: Law No. 7593/2025 on Personal Data Protection
leads.issuing_authority: National Congress; promulgated by the Executive
leads.note: Comprehensive data protection law promulgated November 2025 (creates the Agencia Nacional de Protección de Datos Personales; reported to include a right to challenge solely automated decisions; two-year transition to November 2027). Official full text not reached: Gaceta Oficial site unreachable (connection reset/503), the BACN law collection ends at 2024 laws, SILpy is a script-only app. Promote under data-privacy once the gazette text is read.
